summary: Backend-only retest of the 2 fixes from iteration_2. Ran full pytest suite (50 tests: 25 iter-1 auth/consultation + 15 iter-2 kiosk/queue/TV/start-complete + 9 new iter-3 retest cases) — ALL 50 PASSED (100%). Fix 1 verified: safe_object_id is now applied to POST /api/consultation-requests/{id}/action, GET /api/consultation-requests/{id}, GET /api/consultations/{id}, PATCH /api/consultations/{id}, PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/read — all return 400 for malformed IDs (previously 500 on /action). Fix 2 verified: accept branch now copies queue_id, queue_number and consultation_type from the kiosk-originated consultation_request into the created consultation. Full end-to-end kiosk-to-queue flow validated: (1) kiosk POST creates queue entry with queue_id + increments queue_number; (2) resulting consultation_request has queue_id + queue_number; (3) faculty accept creates consultation carrying queue_id/queue_number/consultation_type='individual'; (4) POST /consultations/{id}/start flips linked queue entry to 'serving' — confirmed via TV display showing correct now_serving.queue_number and faculty availability='busy'; (5) POST /consultations/{id}/complete flips queue to 'completed', faculty back to 'available', TV display now_serving cleared and waiting_count=0. Decline path verified: declining a kiosk-originated request cancels its linked queue entry (queue endpoint returns empty waiting list, status set to 'cancelled'). No new bugs found. Both previously reported issues are resolved.
action_items: No action items — both reported bugs are fixed and all 50 backend tests pass. Backend is ready.

LOW (carry-over from iter 1, still open, not blocking): Split server.py (>1100 lines) into routers (auth, faculty, consultations, kiosk, tv, notifications); enforce JWT_SECRET_KEY presence at startup; guard POST /api/seed behind an env flag before production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still >1100 lines — consider splitting into routers before further growth.

Faculty availability is still auto-flipped to busy/available on start/complete without checking for a manual 'unavailable' state — may override an explicit setting. Not a bug per current spec, but worth confirming with product.
POST /api/seed is public with no auth — fine for dev but should be gated by an env flag or protected before production deployment.
